text: When I bring the sword upon a land: Heb. a land when I bring a sword upon her
whosoever heareth: Heb. he that hearing heareth
lawful and right: Heb. judgment and justice
to be devoured: Heb. to devour him
most desolate: Heb. desolation and desolation
as the people cometh: Heb. according to the coming of the people | sit before thee as my people: Or, my people sit before thee | they show much love: Heb. they make loves or jests
a very lovely song: Heb. a song of loves
